body_url_representation: Exact public text returned by anonymous readback with the website t.co URL expanded; whitespace and punctuation preserved.

verification.method: Anonymous public FxTwitter JSON and original X image response
checks: Exact expanded caption matches submitted caption.
Standalone post with one attached 1600 by 1000 PNG.
PNG dimensions, CRCs, image header, compressed image data and decompressed scanlines verified; visible content matches the corrected-label chart.

chart_scope.claim: 27B v1.1 is one Hard and three overall correct answers behind Jev on this public subset. No speed or cost comparison.
